messages:
alex: Heads up — seeing ~5% of multiplexed SSE connections from eu-west flapping during the probe window after yesterday's routing canary. Reconnect bursts are hitting tenant quotas and console shows a big session churn spike. Anyone else?
tara: ugh. can you paste a small repro/log sample? is it probe-related or auth?
alex: looks probe-y. quick snippet: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Session-Id: sess-42" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?mux=true"
# server replies: :probe
# then connection closed after ~11s, client reconnects with same session id
```
zane: suspect mismatch between proxy probe timer (30s) and runtime idle probe (10s) for multiplexed flows. proxy may send an extra probe that runtime treats as terminal, causing client reconnect.
console-bot: [alert] stream.session-churn (eu-west) > 4.8% for 5m window — created incident INC-9921.
srebot: saw this earlier during sticky-routing rollout — we added a route-affinity change that nudges sessions to new shard. Could cause transient overlapping probes.
tara: can you dump the metrics around reconnect reasons? e.g., stream.reconnect.count by reason/tag.
alex: sample from metrics: 
stream.reconnect.count: 132
stream.reconnect.tags: [reason=probe, route_hash=ab12, resume_token=present]
most are labeled reason=probe, many with same resume_token so it's the same logical session restarting.
zane: UX/console idea: show session lineage for recent reconnects (route_hash timeline + probe_delta). If we could see that in the rollout view we'd spot this immediately.
tara: agree. short-term: can we suppress proxy-level active probe during canary routing flips? maybe set a header X-Probe-Suppress: true for canary traffic. low-risk rollback.
srebot: +1 for suppression flag. Also add a telemetry gauge stream.probe.phase to distinguish probe vs idle-close in console.
azele: (typo) — ignore
zane: procedural ask: alex — can you try a quick proxy patch to honor X-Probe-Suppress and emit metric stream.proxy.probe_suppressed=1 when set? I'll add console tile for lineage and a small canary annotation.
tara: i'll open the console ticket (CON-4382) and add mockup — include route_hash and resume_token columns.
alex: i'll put up a tiny proxy PR to add header handling and the metric, and toggle canary for 10m. will post PR link here.
srebot: also add a short-running alert for reconnect/retry ratio > 2% during rollouts so ops gets early notice.
alex: thanks — will follow up with PR + a short runbook note. :thumbsup:
tara: thx. if this fixes it we'll roll the route-affinity change slowly and keep probe suppression enabled for canaries by default.
